description: ERR-EXCEP and ERR-THREAD, variant: which failing members publish an IErrorInfo (the capture records it per call) besides EXCEPINFO. Each kind is run after a marker failure and followed by an Errors read: (1) OpenRecordset with seven arguments; (2) OpenRecordset with none; (3) Recordset.MoveNext(1); (4) Field.Value put 'abc' into Long N after Edit; (5) Field.Value get of SELECT 1/0; (6) Execute of a statement on a missing table; (7) TableDefs.Item('Nope'); (8) MoveNext on a closed recordset; (9) Update without Edit.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
